claim.claim-text: 2. Linear LED light source according to claim 1, wherein the LED units (12) are sequentially arranged along the longitudinal axis of the sealed lamp envelope (11).
3. Linear LED light source according to claim 1 or 2, wherein at least one LED unit (12) is constituted by a LED filament.

4. Linear LED light source according to any of claims 1 to 3, wherein the light source mount assembly (10) comprises support frames (13a, 13b) to which the LED units (12) are mounted, and that are configured to conduct electric power for driving the LED units (12).

5. Linear LED light source according to any of claims 1 to 4, wherein the light source mount assembly (10) comprises buffer springs (16) that are configured to support the support frames (13a, 13b) against the inner wall of the sealed lamp envelope (11).

6. Linear LED light source according to any of claims 1 to 5, wherein the light source mount assembly (10) comprises isolating bridges (15) that are provided between the support frames (13a, 13b) and are configured to maintain a fixed relative position between the metallic support frames (13a, 13b).
